summary: BE BUG – "N/A" Displays Before Asset Name When Asset Year Is Left Blank
reported_issue: When creating an asset and leaving the Year field blank, the invoice/estimate preview displays "N/A" before the asset name. An initially-blank year was treated differently from a cleared year (which showed no N/A).
expected_after_fix: Invoice/estimate asset block should not display "N/A" when the year is blank; blank and cleared years should render consistently (no N/A).
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin via SPA hydration.
Work Orders -> New -> selected existing customer (Brabay Maintenance).
Clicked Add next to Asset and created a New Asset leaving the Year field blank (also make/model left default-blank), saved the asset.
Saved the Work Order (S9-24948 / da04415b-a237-4832-8175-2bf241b1f113); confirmed via API the vehicle.year = null (initially blank).
Opened Work Order -> Finance tab -> invoice/estimate preview (Estimate EST-S9-24948).
Inspected the Asset block header/value in the preview and scanned full page text for 'N/A'.
actual_now: In the Finance invoice/estimate preview, the Asset column value renders empty for the null-year asset. No 'N/A' string appears anywhere in the preview or asset block. The year prefix is simply omitted when blank.
notes: WO create via API 500s (known session quirk) so WO was created through the SPA UI. PDF text extraction of invoices/preview failed for this PDF format, so verification used the SPA finance invoice-preview render. Asset was created with year null (confirmed via /api/work-orders/view). No N/A prefix observed, matching expected_after_fix.
